Description: Fix and modernize the existing live Marketing Cloud Personalization (MCP) implementation at BBY US and Overstock, per the engagement's "Fix MCP Waterfall Work" framing. Specific root-cause defects driving the remediation are not itemized in the source docs.

Stand up Data 360 (the client's name for Data Cloud) and sync the 4 Customer Data Mesh tables (bi_customer_account, bi_customer_storefront, bi_visit, bi_email_daily_summary) from BigQuery via Zero Copy, ingestion, or a hybrid pattern.

Layer the ~39-attribute Acxiom demographic/financial/lifestyle/property enrichment set onto Data 360 customer records, expanding coverage from the current schema to all three in-scope brands (BBY US, Overstock, BuyBuyBaby).

Identity-resolved, unified-profile-driven activation in MCP: near-real-time event-based messaging, scheduled segment audiences, cross-entity purchase/browse signal activation, value segmentation, and lifecycle targeting.

Activate Data 360 segments (lookalikes, non-marketing-email purchasers, seasonal/category purchasers, new movers, college-affiliated, expectant-family) to paid channels: Google Ads, Facebook, Criteo, Pinterest, TikTok.

10 brand-neutral web use cases including beacon/catalog-feed setup, person-record enrichment with unified ID + 3rd-party attributes, and 5 named campaigns (mortgage targeting, Einstein income-based product recommendations, mover targeting, back-to-college seasonal, patio category segmentation).

7 brand-neutral email use cases, including a mortgage-follow-up open-time-content use case that hands content/data to Braze, a non-Salesforce ESP. The Salesforce delivery team is responsible for building and maintaining that connection, not just producing a one-time export.
